# Constructor failure receiving v1

Status: private source implementation of the connected receiving and final-attempt publication boundaries. No compiler/runtime qualification, application-fit, full-constructor funding or issue-closure claim. This is not the selected replay report protocol.

## First connected boundary

The actual resolved-core attempt acquires one affine `constructor_failure::receiving::Receiver` from its already active builder ledger, immediately before synthetic module construction. It reserves the complete initialized receiving controls and actual one-Diagnostic Vec backing before acquisition; no new budget, allowance, floor, refund or old-header credit exists. Its empty capacity remains genuinely acquired and charged on successful builds and legacy-Many errors. Each retry acquires and pays its own owner under the unchanged per-attempt/max-debit protocol. New cost can cause a formerly fitting boundary to refuse; it is not hidden or normalized.

`Failure::One` moves the complete original Diagnostic into that held slot. The live identity check borrows the original captured ClassifierLedger; a foreign owner poisons the original and retains primary+unused backing inline. Detachment stays sticky after restoration. A correctly bound selected semantic Diagnostic can move after a sticky budget refusal without another reserve, Vec acquisition, formatting or replacement of any field. The original budget remains authoritative and the enclosing attempt still captures its first receipt. `Failure::Many` moves every existing element/order/backing and remains explicitly legacy: neither the Vec nor its payload becomes certified paid by this receiver.

The slot certifies only its actual receiving backing. Original Diagnostic message/path/help ownership remains with its original producer. In particular old helper-internal dynamic limit/help construction is not silently funded by the slot. A published owner retains the same ledger through restoration; moving the held Vec at compatibility output does not re-enter or reset it.

Setup refusal remains typed/inline through the actual attempt result. Only Budget maps to the original builder-byte diagnostic using the captured maximum. NoOwner, Allocation, Capacity and Arithmetic are distinct internal setup refusals, never invented byte receipts. The compatibility adapter materializes their report explicitly outside the funded receiving boundary. The full primary survives foreign association; a secondary authority error never replaces it.

## Typed setup compatibility contract

A setup failure is selected before the core body runs. NoOwner, Allocation, Capacity, Detached and Arithmetic have no invented prior byte-refusal equivalence: they publish `SPX-G173`, Error, the following exact message, and path/span/help all None at the explicitly unfunded legacy adapter. A captured Budget failure alone preserves the complete original `limit_error("builder_bytes", maximum)` report using its captured maximum. An already selected primary remains authoritative when receiving or publication later fails.

| Setup | Exact compatibility message |
| --- | --- |
| NoOwner | constructor report receiver has no active builder owner |
| Allocation | constructor report receiving allocation refused |
| Capacity | constructor report receiving capacity differs from its paid request |
| Detached | constructor report receiver is detached from its original builder owner |
| Arithmetic | constructor report receiving layout overflowed |

These setup forms are owning internal consistency/storage diagnoses. They do not reclassify an original semantic diagnostic or claim G171 numeric fields. The report-capacity failure is terminal on its affine owner; retrying cannot append another suffix. There is no new spend authority on restoration.

## Complete independent prior receiver

The entire previous `build_resolved_core_current` body is compiled in a test-only child, including its original One-to-Vec conversion and every helper/order/error. Its only lexical adapter is function visibility plus explicit imports. Complete old defaults/stubs/overlay/Failure remain unchanged. Source controls compare the whole original body, full linked HIR and generated C; builder debit metadata deliberately changes and is never normalized to force equality.

Authored receiving controls cover exact/one-short/zero setup, actual slot pointer/capacity, all six static diagnostic fields, prior sticky first receipt, foreign/restored detachment, complete Many order/dynamic fields/JSON, unused-slot Drop, and whole construct-to-Drop physical backing. They are unexecuted until the owning grouped build/run records results.

## Connected final-attempt publication

Before the actual resolved-core child executes its first reservation, `attempt::run` acquires a separate affine report owner from that same active ledger. It pays all declared initialized receiving controls, one Diagnostic Vec slot, and two String backing capacities before construction. The message and borrowed current base-help lengths are measured without allocating. The suffix capacity is explicitly bounded by three usize decimal representations and the longest member of the closed current ReservationStage label inventory (including unknown). This is a capacity bound, not an exact live payload byte claim. Every actual allocated capacity remains charged even when no error is published; retries get no refund or cross-attempt credit.

The first two actual attempt reservations return typed Setup::Budget on refusal without creating a Diagnostic, help string or Vec. Other helper APIs retain their legacy behavior until separately migrated. After the core body returns, the owner authenticates its original ledger and seals the captured first receipt while that child is still ACTIVE. A fixed writer rejects capacity overflow before push and cannot grow String backing. It moves the finished Diagnostic into the held Vec. The final exhausted retry moves this paid report after child restoration. If the report owner could not be acquired or detached, the actual allocating old compatibility fallback remains explicit; no fabricated receipt or replacement byte authority is invented.

The former complete limit_error, builder_bytes_help and live_builder_refusal bodies remain independently compiled with only imports/visibility adapted, and complete original bytes are archived. Borrowed formatting changes only the output writer; all seven original help branches, branch priority, Unicode/NUL path bytes, literals and field order remain represented. New source-authored controls cover these branches, first-receipt fields, exact/short/zero and unused storage, foreign/restored owner, no body entry after setup refusal, closed label ordinal inventory, whole construct-to-Drop backing and full original formatter equality. They have not executed.

## Still required for OPT825

1. Typed reservation propagation through the complete default/field/stub/overlay route must avoid the old post-refusal dynamic `limit_error` construction. Legacy helper failure Vecs stay visible until each real producer is migrated; do not call the whole receiving path paid.
2. An additive affine typed outward result must carry unacquired Setup/no-owner failures inline and the original selected paid owner through actual callers. The old owned-Vec API cannot create positive backing from a zero/exhausted owner; it remains an honestly allocating compatibility route. Merely adding an unused API does not satisfy adoption. Setup Allocation/Capacity/Detached/Arithmetic map to distinct honest G173 compatibility messages, with no invented old byte-failure equivalence; that compatibility allocation is not funded by an absent owner.
3. Qualify the complete old/current default/import/receiving/core/final-report bodies with full six-field/error order, UTF8/NUL, dynamic paths/help and real Many controls; exact/short/zero/every acquired frontier, first sticky association, complete same-observer Drop, actual caller source binding and all corresponding source inverses. Existing application/cap failures remain disclosed.

No private selected-replay781 or identity-report owner is reused. No work-unit/quota/cap/forecast change is authorized by this protocol.

## Typed helper propagation (partial successor)

The actual core passes the same affine Receiver by mutable borrow into a separate typed overlay/stub/default/field route. It captures the original builder maximum at acquisition and retains its first typed setup failure. Each reserve checks that saved failure before attempting any later charge; an unfunded foreign invocation cannot donate its active ledger. A physical field-capacity exit authenticates the original identity before recording the same inherited maximum-size refusal. It remains a builder-byte refusal and is never relabelled Allocation.

Typed helper entries reserve their complete returned Result and borrowed receiving-reference layout before output acquisition; text construction additionally pays its String initializer and checks the bounded string helper's refusal sentinel before creating later backing. Field growth retains full replacement-array charges, evaluation order, and the original growth frontier. Extra fees are real and remain cumulative. The enlarged original owner and every unused receiving slot remain paid on success and all other branches.

Semantic One still moves through the original slot and keeps all six selected fields even after a secondary sticky/detached association. A typed Budget moves inline to the existing attempt owner, which seals its original first receipt while the child is ACTIVE. No diagnostic/Vec formatting occurs at that propagation step. Complete previous helpers remain compiled under cfg(test), with whole-source inverses retaining their unchanged bodies. Existing G171 dynamic compatibility remains independent.

This does not complete OPT825: registry, structural census/cost, layout, alias/type rewriting and provider-internal diagnostic producers still have legacy return ownership. Many keeps its real prior backing without paid reclassification. The public/no-owner outward Vec adapter remains explicitly allocating; no additive externally adopted typed outward API is claimed. New controls and source proofs require grouped compiler/runtime qualification before any funding claim.


## Typed overlay directory successor

The actual typed overlay's type, combined type-index and function directories
now borrow its original affine Receiver. Each helper pays the complete returned
Result, Vec initializer, count, checked Layout/result controls and complete exact
backing before acquisition. The GeneratedRoots initializer is paid before its
first directory is built. Empty directories retain those real control charges.
No legacy charge is credited or refunded; unchanged caps can refuse earlier.

A denied reservation returns typed Setup through the existing core and original
attempt owner without creating a Diagnostic or error Vec. Checked layout or
physical capacity failure authenticates that same owner and uses its inherited
maximum-size physical refusal. The first setup remains sticky across retries and
foreign/restored associations. The complete original directory helper and both
old overlay receivers remain independently compiled and unchanged.

Private source-authored controls compare exact-count contents/capacity and whole
Drop, every byte frontier including zero/exact/short, no allocation after selected
refusal, foreign/restored association, oversized layout, three live call sites and
complete immediate source inverses. They have not run. Structural-cost/census,
checked count arithmetic, registry/layout derivation, rewrite/provider and
public/no-owner outward producers remain explicit residuals. This successor makes
no runtime, savings, application-fit or whole-constructor funding claim.


## Typed raw-cost and default-teardown census successor

The actual overlay now uses separately compiled typed copies of the complete raw
field/type/signature/function/expression/pattern visitors, accumulator formulas,
and recursive expanded-default teardown census. Original visitors, accumulators
and geometric teardown payments remain independently compiled. All 15 raw cost
and identity/storage census fields keep their formulas and update order; the
fourfold teardown census and original once-per-worklist minimum are unchanged.

The same original affine Receiver pays actual returned controls, borrowed
arguments, accumulator and census initializer storage before traversal, then
pays the original raw clone/teardown backing before acquisition. Sized references
are measured from actual arguments; borrowed str/slice arguments retain their
fat-pointer layout. These controls are new cumulative debits, with no refund,
old-layout credit, guessed replacement fee, work-unit change or cap increase.

A logical checked-cost overflow or maximum breach keeps the original captured
maximum inline and selects no invented physical sticky receipt: the original
checked_usage also returned its semantic cap error without reserving. Actual
reservation failure retains the ledger's original first receipt. Both paths
retain the Receiver's first Setup and original owner authentication. They
propagate to the existing attempt/report owner without a helper Diagnostic or
error Vec. Logical-only Setup still reaches the explicitly allocating old public
adapter, which preserves the old six-field G171 value; this successor does not
fund or adopt a new outward API.

Source-authored controls compare all 15 cost fields over the complete std
collection/memory source visitors plus scalar/control/type fixtures, whole Drop,
every byte frontier of the retained-function cost/payment chain, sticky retry,
foreign/restored association and logical-only cap compatibility without a fake
receipt. Existing complete old/core/overlay/report controls remain required and
unexecuted in this packet. The source audits join both new children.

Registry/layout derivation and its scoped ledger, structural prebound consumers
outside this actual constructor chain, alias/type rewriting, provider-internal
producers, checked overlay count arithmetic and public/no-owner compatibility
remain real residuals. No savings, runtime, application-fit, full-constructor
funding or OPT825 closure is claimed.


## Typed imported-signature rewriting successor

Actual typed overlay parameter and return signatures now borrow the original
Receiver through an independent rewriting successor. Identity lookup retains
provider/local/type-import/prelude priority but borrows exact source-held or
static identity bytes instead of creating intermediate owned identity Strings.

alias checks remain. No borrowed identity supplies new import or layout authority.

compiled, with complete immediate source custody and inverse joins.

Returned controls, actual borrowed argument layouts, Diagnostic/String
initializers and exact dynamic message backing are paid before acquisition.

produces no helper Diagnostic or error Vec. A missing-import message uses exact
paid String capacity and cannot grow; all six original Diagnostic fields and
